chunks: From him, from Abū ʿAlī al-Ashʿarī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about the mutamattiʿ: if he is an elderly shaykh, or a woman who fears menstruation, may he hasten the tawaf of hajj before coming to Minā? He said: Yes, whoever is like that may hasten it.

key_terms.شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا: an elderly man of advanced age
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْحَجِّ: the tawaf associated with hajj rites
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the well-known location of hajj rituals
key_terms.يُعَجِّلُ: he brings forward or performs earlier

ai.seo_question: Can an elderly pilgrim or a woman fearing menstruation perform the tawaf of hajj before going to Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the pilgrim performing tamattuʿ in hajj. It permits an elderly person or a woman who fears the onset of menstruation to perform the tawaf of hajj earlier, before going to Minā, due to their circumstance.
